# Poothali Homestay

> Traditional heritage homestay in Kasaragod, North Malabar, Kerala, offering authentic cultural experiences including Theyyam rituals, Malabar cuisine, and sustainable village tourism near Bekal Fort.

Poothali is a paddyview homestay located in the Tulunadu region of North Kerala, specializing in immersive cultural experiences, farm-to-table dining, and responsible tourism. The homestay serves as a gateway to exploring Kasaragod's rich heritage, coastal trails, traditional crafts, and the sacred Theyyam art form.
